result.stdout:
Ward - Cross-Framework .NET Assembly Obfuscation & IP Protection Tool
Usage: ward <command> [assembly-path] [options]

Commands:
  protect <assembly-path>  Obfuscates the target assembly with configured passes.
  analyze <assembly-path>  Inspects and reports public API surface and obfuscation decisions.
  version                  Displays version and runtime information.

Options:
  -o, --output <path>      Specify output assembly file path or directory.
  --no-preserve-public     Disable public API preservation (obfuscates everything).
  --no-control-flow        Disable method body control flow obfuscation.
  --no-string-encryption   Disable string literal encryption.
  --no-reference-proxy     Disable external call reference proxying.
  --no-anti-tamper         Disable module anti-tampering guards.
  --no-strip-metadata      Disable metadata and parameter name stripping.
  -s, --scheme <scheme>    Naming scheme: RandomAlphanumeric, ShortAlpha, UnicodeConfusable, Hash.
  -r, --reference-dir <dir> Add reference assembly search directory.
  --exclude-ns <namespace> Exclude namespace prefix from renaming.
  --exclude-type <type>    Exclude specific type from renaming.
